name: causal-powers
description: Superpowers for data analytics, causal inference, and econometrics: discipline skills that make the silent failures of data work loud — data contracts, data preparation, join-cardinality checks, wrong-number debugging, result verification, pre-analysis plans, causal identification, structural estimation (demand/BLP, dynamic discrete choice, games, auctions, consideration, search), analysis craft, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, plan execution with parallel subagents, and research-project organization. R, Julia, and Python.
